title: validation.json — trusted validator pass results
description: One trusted `prompts/validate.md` pass over a review's candidate findings, written beside review.json. The invoker runs the pass; verdict only reads the file, so a review never spawns a model. A CONFIRMED result changes nothing, a DOWNGRADED one moves the severity exactly one rank with a history event, and a REJECTED one warns in advisory mode or withholds the finding in gate mode. The validator's reason is stored and never quoted as a finding's evidence. post.json and record.json record the SHA-256 of these exact bytes.

head_sha.description: The bundle HEAD the pass judged. A mismatch with the bundle refuses validation-stale: the validator reviewed a different tree.

validator.description: Optional provenance of the pass: the model, the SHA-256 of the prompt file it read, and when it started.

results.description: One result per judged finding. A sig no finding resolves refuses bad-validation.

verdict.description: CONFIRMED keeps the finding as written; DOWNGRADED moves it one severity rank and needs from_severity/to_severity; REJECTED withholds it in gate mode and warns in advisory mode.

reason.description: The validator's evidence, 10-500 characters. Stored on the receipt and never posted as a finding's evidence.

checks.description: Which checks the pass ran, in order. Unknown names are dropped with a warning.
